content_sections.heading: NIMHANS Psychologist Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NIMHANS Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NIMHANS Psychologist Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NIMHANS Psychologist Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Masters in Psychology, MPhil in Clinical Psychology, PhD in Psychology. Fluency in reading and writing in Kannada and English is essential.

content_sections.heading: NIMHANS Psychologist Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the NIMHANS Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the NIMHANS Psychologist post is scheduled for 05 October 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the NIMHANS Psychologist position?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification includes a Masters in Psychology, MPhil in Clinical Psychology, or a PhD in Psychology. Fluency in Kannada and English is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the NIMHANS Psychologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Psychologist post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Psychologist post at NIMHANS?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in-cum-Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIMHANS Psychologist recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for NIMHANS Psychologist to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the NIMHANS office in Bangalore, Karnataka, with the pincode 560029.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Psychologist position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Psychologist position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NIMH/PROJ/KVB/P/2022/C9/C17NOTIF/2026-2027.
